stages.intro: Look around. What is wrong with this plant?
stages.predict: Make a prediction before you touch anything.

experiment.testPrediction: Let's test your prediction. Drag the sun higher.
experiment.tryOther: Light helped. Does more water help too? Grab the watering can.
experiment.keyMoment: Why didn't that help? Look at what is still holding the plant back.
experiment.ready: Light was the limiting factor. But where does the light actually get used? Zoom into a leaf.

zoom.co2path: Trace the CO₂: click the stoma, then the air space, a mesophyll cell and a chloroplast.
zoom.leaf: Path traced. Click the glowing mesophyll cell to go inside.
zoom.cell: About 30–40 chloroplasts per cell. Click a chloroplast to zoom in.
zoom.chloroplast: Thylakoids stacked into grana, floating in the stroma. Open the two stages.
zoom.whatIf: Your classmate says the light reactions don't need the Calvin cycle. Predict first.
zoom.coupling: Test it: remove CO₂ with the light on, then switch the light off.
zoom.hypothesis: Where does the O₂ come from? Pin a hypothesis.
zoom.isotope: Drag the ¹⁸O tag onto H₂O or CO₂ in the chloroplast.
zoom.ledger: Place every atom in the product it ends up in.
zoom.ready: You traced CO₂, tested both stages and tracked the atoms. Explain it.

stages.explain: Use your evidence to explain what happened.
stages.explain2: Now explain the chloroplast: where O₂ comes from and why the stages need each other.

apply.start: A new plant, a new problem. Find what is limiting it and fix it.
apply.wrongFirst: Activity barely moved. What is this plant really missing?
apply.solved: The plant is recovering. One last question.

challenge.why: Diagnosis correct. Justify it in a sentence.
challenge.passed: Challenge passed. Write up your lab sheet.
challenge.done: All cases attempted. Write up your lab sheet.

stages.report: Your lab sheet is filled from your evidence. Edit the conclusion, then see your mastery report.

changes.limitingUp: {Var} {from} → {to}. Activity rose {aFrom} → {aTo} because {var} was the limiting factor.
changes.nonLimitingUp: {Var} {from} → {to}. Activity stayed at {aTo}: {limiting} {isAre} still the limiting {factor}.
changes.coLimitedUp: {Var} {from} → {to}. Activity stayed at {aTo}: {limiting} {isAre} also limiting the plant.
changes.becameLimiting: {Var} {from} → {to}. Activity fell {aFrom} → {aTo}. {Var} is now the limiting factor.

comparison.supported: Your prediction was supported by this experiment.
comparison.different: Your prediction was different from the result. Look at the light reaching the leaves and compare the activity before and after your change. What does this evidence suggest?
comparison.observed: Increasing light increased the activity while light was the limiting factor.

model: Simplified model: activity = the lowest of light, water and CO₂. Real photosynthesis depends on many more factors and is not perfectly linear.
